title: Prime next-day deliveries delayed across multiple regions
situation: Customers are frustrated by delayed Prime shipments and unhelpful support responses, requiring an immediate batch reply and logistics escalation before sentiment worsens further.
hypothesis: Carrier network delays affecting guaranteed delivery times

params.reply_en: We are sorry your Prime delivery is running late. We are looking into the carrier delay with our logistics team and will update your tracking shortly.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر عن تأخر توصيل طلبك السريع. نتابع حالياً تأخير الناقل مع فريق الخدمات اللوجستية وسيتم تحديث حالة تتبعك قريباً.

actions.why: Acknowledge the delay and reassure customers in their preferred language.

params.note: Widespread Prime delivery delays reported by multiple customers.

actions.why: Notify the logistics team to investigate carrier performance.

actions.title: Prime Delivery Delays

actions.answer_ar: نواجه حالياً تأخيرات بسيطة من شركة الشحن في طلبات بريم. يرجى مراجعة رابط التتبع للحصول على آخر التحديثات.
